declarations.description:
Every user-facing string Peacock renders on its own: labels for icon buttons, screen-reader text,
empty states, toolbar names. Apps translate them once with `setPeacockStrings()`; components that
render many strings also take a per-instance `strings` property. A string with values is a function.

Numbers and dates are formatted with `Intl` in the resolved locale, never here.

default. Every connected component re-renders with the new strings.

declarations.name: setIconBase
declarations.description:
Loads a provider's icons from `base`, a folder holding `<name>.svg`, instead of cdn.jsdelivr.net:
for pages that must not leave their own origin, such as an intranet or a page whose content
security policy allows only `connect-src 'self'`. A relative `base` resolves against the page.
`loader-full.js` does this for Material Symbols with the icons it ships in `icons/`.

declarations.name: IndividualComponent
declarations.description:
Build marker, not a runtime decorator: it does nothing when the class is defined.

`rollup.config.js` scans `src/` for `@IndividualComponent` and gives every marked class its own
entry file in `dist/` (for example `dist/button.js`), which the loader imports lazily the first
time the tag appears on the page. Mark every public component class with it; leave it off
internal building blocks that should only ship inside another component's bundle.

declarations.name: dispatchActivationClick
declarations.description:
Dispatches a click event to the given element that triggers a native action,
but is not composed and therefore is not seen outside the element.

This is useful for responding to an external click event on the host element
that should trigger an internal action like a button click.

Note, a helper is provided because setting this up correctly is a bit tricky.
In particular, calling `click` on an element creates a composed event, which
is not desirable, and a manually dispatched event must specifically be a
`MouseEvent` to trigger a native action.

declarations.name: isActivationClick
declarations.description:
Returns true if the click event should trigger an activation behavior. The
behavior is defined by the element and is whatever it should do when
clicked.

Typically when an element needs to handle a click, the click is generated
from within the element and an event listener within the element implements
the needed behavior; however, it's possible to fire a click directly
at the element that the element should handle. This method helps
distinguish these "external" clicks.

An "external" click can be triggered in a number of ways: via a click
on an associated label for a form  associated element, calling
`element.click()`, or calling
`element.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', ...))`.

Also works around Firefox issue
https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1804576 by squelching
events for a microtask after called.

declarations.description:
Add a hook for an event that is called after the event is dispatched and
propagates to other event listeners.

This is useful for behaviors that need to check if an event is canceled.

The callback is invoked synchronously, which allows for better integration
with synchronous platform APIs (like `<form>` or `<label>` clicking).

Note: `setupDispatchHooks()` must be called on the element before adding any
other event listeners. Call it in the constructor of an element or
controller.

This function is safe to call multiple times with the same element or event
types. Call it in the constructor of elements, mixins, and controllers to
ensure it is set up before external listeners.

declarations.name: nativeValidity
declarations.description: The validity of a native control, for controls that wrap one.

Base class for Peacock's form controls.

It is form-associated: `value` is submitted with the surrounding `<form>`, `form.reset()`
restores the value the control started with, and a disabled `<fieldset>` disables it.
`name` and `disabled` come from `mixinFormAssociated`; they are backed by attributes, so
subclasses must not redeclare them.

It takes part in constraint validation like a native control: `required` and the control's own
rules (from `computeValidity()`) block form submission, `checkValidity()`, `reportValidity()`,
`setCustomValidity()`, `validity` and `validationMessage` work as on `<input>`, and `:invalid`
matches. A control shows its message (`validationText`) once the person has committed a value
or the form was submitted.
declarations.name: BaseInput

members.name: value
members.description: Each control declares its own `value` (a property, or an accessor such as Switch's).

members.name: showValidity
members.description: Whether to show the validation message: after a commit, or after a failed submit.

members.name: __defaultValue
members.description: The value the control had when it was first connected; `form.reset()` returns to it.

members.name: setCustomValidity
members.description: Sets a custom error message, as on `<input>`; an empty string clears it.

members.name: computeValidity
members.description:
The control's own validity. The default checks `required` against an empty `value`;
controls that wrap a native input return `nativeValidity(input)`, others add their rules.

members.name: valueMissingText
members.description: The message for a missing required value.

members.name: updateValidity
members.description: Pushes the current validity to `ElementInternals`.

members.name: validityAnchor
members.description: The element the browser points at when it reports a problem.

members.name: validationText
members.description: The message to show under the control, or '' while there is nothing to show.

members.name: parseRestoreState
members.description: Turns saved form state back into a value. Strings by default.

declarations.description:
Roving tabindex for a set of items (toolbar actions, tabs, list items, accordion headers):
one item is the tab stop (`tabindex="0"`), the others `-1`; arrow keys, Home and End move focus
between them, mirroring Left/Right in right-to-left layouts.

The host attaches `handleKeyDown` and `handleFocusIn` to the element that contains the items
(or its host), and calls `sync()` when the items change (on `slotchange` and after updates).
declarations.name: RovingFocusController

members.name: activeItem
members.description: The item that holds the tab stop.

members.name: sync
members.description: Re-applies the tab stops; call after the items change.

members.name: setActive
members.description: Makes `item` the tab stop, and focuses it unless `focus` is false.

members.name: handleFocusIn
members.description: Keeps the tab stop on the item that got focus by click or Tab.

members.name: typeaheadTarget
members.description: The next item whose text starts with the typed characters (a 500 ms buffer, like native).

declarations.description:
Shared behaviour for Peacock overlays (modal, side and bottom sheets, popover, tooltip,
snackbar): the top layer, so overlays stack in the order they open and never sit under an
open modal; a ref-counted page scroll lock for modal overlays; Escape and light dismiss that
close only the topmost overlay; initial focus and focus return.

The host keeps `open` as the source of truth: it calls `sync(open)` from `updated()`, and the
controller calls `requestClose(reason)` when the user asks to close. The host then sets
`open = false` and fires its `close` event with that reason.

For a dialog surface's native `close` event: true when this controller closed the dialog,
false when the browser did (a form with `method="dialog"`, for example). The event arrives a

treating the event as a close of their own.

declarations.description:
The menu wiring shared by buttons that open a `wc-menu` (dropdown button, split button):
show / close / toggle, Arrow Up / Down on the trigger, the trigger's `aria-haspopup`,
`aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, and the host's `open` / `close` events (ADR-030001).

The menu's own `open` / `close` events are stopped inside the host, which fires its own `open`
and `close` instead; `close` carries `detail.reason` from the menu's close event. The host renders the menu with `id=${trigger.menuId}`, `@open=${trigger.handleMenuOpen}`
and `@close=${trigger.handleMenuClose}`, and the trigger button with
`.configAria=${trigger.triggerAria}`, `@click=${trigger.handleTriggerClick}` and
`@keydown=${trigger.handleTriggerKeyDown}`.

declarations.description:
Base class for Peacock's text-like fields (input, textarea, number, URL, select, date/time,
color). It adds the props every field shares (label, helper/error/warning text, variant, size,
clearable, `start`/`end` slots) and renders the `wc-field` frame.

It also makes the inner control accessible across the shadow boundary: `fieldAria()` gives it
an accessible name from `label`, `aria-invalid` while an error shows, and `aria-describedby`
pointing at a hidden copy of the helper or error text in the same shadow root.

Subclasses call `renderField(control, options)` in `render()`, spread `fieldAria()` onto the
native control, call `emitValue('input' | 'change')` instead of re-dispatching native events
(the field event contract: `CustomEvent<{ value }>`, bubbling and composed), and override
`clearValue()` if clearing means more than `value = ''`.

declarations.description:
The wall-clock fields `date` shows in `timeZone` (an IANA name such as `America/New_York`),
read from `Intl.DateTimeFormat#formatToParts`. Throws a `RangeError` for an unknown zone.

declarations.name: toZonedWallClock
declarations.description:
A `Date` whose local fields show the wall-clock time `date` has in `timeZone`, so the views can
lay it out with local getters. An empty or unknown zone returns a copy of `date`.

declarations.name: formatDate
declarations.description:
Formats a date for display in `locale`. The patterns name the `en-US` output; other locales get
their own month and day names, order and clock. `dd-MM-yyyy` is a fixed key, not display text.

declarations.description:
Base for text fields that open a picker in a popover: `wc-date-field`, `wc-time-field` and
`wc-datetime-field`.

The field keeps the typed text in `draft` and parses it on blur or Enter. Valid text becomes
`value` (always ISO, so forms submit a locale-independent value) and fires `change`; text that
does not parse, or falls outside `min`/`max`, keeps the draft, shows an error and makes the
field invalid (`badInput`, `rangeUnderflow` or `rangeOverflow`). Values picked in the popover
fire `input` while they change and `change` once committed.

Subclasses supply the parsing, formatting, validation and the picker itself.

declarations.description:
Base for Peacock's on/off controls: `wc-checkbox`, `wc-switch` and `wc-radio`.

Like a native checkbox, `checked` is the state and `value` the string submitted under `name`
while checked (`"on"` by default). `required` blocks form submission until the control is
checked. The inner control (an element with class `container` and a `role`) gets the host's
`tabindex` and `aria-*`, and is named by the visible label through `aria-labelledby`.

Subclasses render the control with `controlAttributes()`, the label with `renderLabel()`, and
call `toggleChecked(event)` (or their own selection logic) on activation.

declarations.name: getPageItems
declarations.description:
Builds the page list shown by the `full` pagination variant.

The list always keeps the first and last page, the current page and `siblings` pages on each
side of it, and fills the rest with an ellipsis. It never holds more than
`2 * siblings + 5` slots, so the control keeps its width while the user moves through pages.

declarations.description:
The rendered columns in visual order: the selection column, the row expander, start-pinned,
scrolling and end-pinned data columns, then the column menu. Hidden columns are left out.

declarations.name: totalWidth
declarations.description: Sum of the columns' starting widths in rem: the row's minimum width.

declarations.name: buildHeaderGroups
declarations.description:
The column group header row, or `undefined` when no visible column has a `group`. Neighbouring
columns with the same group and placement share a cell; other columns get an empty cell.

declarations.name: moveColumnTo
declarations.description:
The column order after dropping `name` on `targetName`: before it when moving towards the start,
after it when moving towards the end. `undefined` when the two are pinned differently.

declarations.name: moveColumnBy
declarations.description:
The column order after moving `name` by `delta` places among the visible columns of its
pinned group, or `undefined` when it cannot move that way.

declarations.name: reconcileColumnState
declarations.description:
Carries the column state over to a new `columns` array: overrides for columns that are gone are
dropped, and so are overrides of a `width` or `hidden` the new configuration changed.

declarations.name: nextGridPosition
declarations.description:
The cell an arrow, Home or End key moves to, or `undefined` for any other key. In right-to-left
layouts the left and right arrows swap, so they follow what is on screen.

declarations.name: clampGridPosition
declarations.description: Keeps a position inside the grid after rows or columns went away.

declarations.name: horizontalDirection
declarations.description: `1` for a key that moves towards the end of the row, `-1` towards the start, else `0`.

declarations.name: cellClasses
declarations.description: Classes of a cell in any row.

declarations.name: cellStyle
declarations.description: Flex sizing of a cell, or of a group header cell over `entries`.

declarations.name: renderRowGroups
declarations.description: Splits a row's cells into the start-pinned, scrolling and end-pinned groups.

declarations.name: renderCellContent
declarations.description: A data cell's content: the column template, or the field value as text.

declarations.name: renderHeaderLabel
declarations.description: A column header's label: the header template, or the column label. Strings are text.

declarations.name: getRowKey
declarations.description:
The key of a row as a string. Keys from attributes are always strings, so a numeric `id` is
compared as `"1"`, not `1`.

declarations.name: normalizeKeys
declarations.description: Converts every key to a string; returns the same array when nothing changes.

declarations.name: toggleKey
declarations.description: `keys` with `key` added or removed.

declarations.name: togglePageKeys
declarations.description:
The selection after the select-all checkbox: every key in `pageKeys` when some are missing,
otherwise none of them. Keys outside `pageKeys` stay as they are.

declarations.name: compareValues
declarations.description: Compares numbers by value and everything else as text with natural number order. Empty values sort last.

declarations.name: sortRows
declarations.description: A sorted copy of `rows`, by each sort level in turn.

declarations.name: nextSorts
declarations.description:
The sort levels after a header activation. A plain click sorts by this column only, cycling
ascending, descending and off. With `additive` (Shift), the column cycles in place and other
levels stay; a new column is added as the lowest level.

declarations.name: normalizeSorts
declarations.description: Drops empty and repeated levels from a sorts list set by the consumer.

declarations.name: aggregateValue
declarations.description:
A column's footer value over `rows`, or `undefined` when there is none (no aggregate, or no
numbers to sum). `count` counts the rows.

declarations.name: editorKind
declarations.description: The editor of a column: its `editor`, else `"number"` for number columns, else `"text"`.

declarations.name: commitsOnChange
declarations.description:
True for editors whose `change` is a pick (an option, a date, a toggle) that commits the edit.
Text and number editors commit on Enter or when focus leaves.

declarations.name: renderEditor
declarations.description: The field that edits a cell holding `value`, named `label` for assistive technology.

declarations.name: readEditorValue
declarations.description: The value in an editor: a boolean for checkboxes, a number (or undefined) for numbers.

declarations.name: csvText
declarations.description: The text a value becomes in a CSV cell, before quoting.

declarations.name: csvField
declarations.description: One CSV field, quoted as RFC 4180 asks when it holds a quote, comma or line break.

declarations.name: exportCellValue
declarations.description: The value a column exports for a row: `exportValue`, else the raw field.

declarations.name: toCsv
declarations.description: CSV text: a header row of column labels, then one line per row, lines ending in CRLF.

declarations.name: virtualWindow
declarations.description:
The items a virtual list renders: those in view, with `overscan` extra items on each side.
Shared by `wc-table` (virtual body) and `wc-virtual-list`. Every item has the same height.

declarations.name: groupKeyOf
declarations.description: The group key of a value: the value as a string, `''` for `undefined` and `null`.

declarations.name: groupRows
declarations.description:
Splits rows into groups by `field`. Groups are ordered by value (`asc` or `desc`, empty values
last), or by first appearance with `"appearance"`. Rows keep their order inside a group.

declarations.name: buildDisplayItems
declarations.description:
The rows rendered for `rows[start, end)`: a header before each group that has rows in the
range (collapsed groups show the header only) and a detail row after each expanded row.
`aria-rowindex` counts every item over all of `rows`, so it stays right across pages; `count`
is that total, for `aria-rowcount`.

declarations.name: writeClipboardText
declarations.description:
Writes `text` to the clipboard: with `navigator.clipboard.writeText` when the browser has it,
else, or when it rejects, with a hidden textarea and `execCommand('copy')`.

Call it from a user gesture (a click or a key press); browsers refuse clipboard writes
otherwise.

declarations.name: textToCopyFrom
declarations.description:
The text a copy button copies from `element`: the value of an `input`, `textarea` or
`select`, else its text content.

declarations.name: Table

cssProperties.description: Minimum height of a row. Set by `density`. With `virtual`, the fixed height of every row.
cssProperties.name: --table-row-height

cssProperties.description: Color of the row dividers.
cssProperties.name: --table-border-color

cssProperties.description: Horizontal padding of a cell.
cssProperties.name: --table-cell-padding-inline

slots.description: Actions shown in the selection bar while rows are selected.
slots.name: bulk-actions

slots.description: Content under the table, usually a `wc-pagination`. In client mode the table pages its rows with it; with `managed`, handle its `page` event and load the page yourself.
slots.name: footer

slots.description: Content shown when there are no rows. Defaults to an empty state.
slots.name: empty

slots.description: Content shown while `error` is set. Defaults to an error empty state.
slots.name: error

members.name: columns
members.description:
Grid columns configuration. Each column can have: name, label, width, minWidth, maxWidth
and flex (rem and grow factor), fixed, align, type, sortable, wrap, hidden, hideable,
resizable, reorderable, group, headerTemplate, template; editable, editor, options,
required, min, max, step and validate for inline editing; exportValue; aggregate.

members.name: data
members.description: Grid data to display on table.

members.name: selection
members.description:
How rows are selected: `none` (default), `single` (one row, with radio buttons) or
`multiple` (checkboxes, a select-all checkbox and the selection bar).

members.name: selectedRowKeys
members.description:
Keys of the selected rows. Keys are compared as strings, so a numeric `id` of `1` matches
`"1"`.

members.name: isRowSelectable
members.description:
Decides whether a row can be selected. Rows it returns `false` for show a disabled control
and are skipped by select-all.

members.name: keyField
members.description: The field name used as the unique key for each row. Defaults to `"id"`.

members.name: managed
members.description:
If true, sorting and pagination are managed externally (controlled mode): the table shows
`data` as given and only reports `sort` and page changes.

members.name: sortable
members.description: If true, columns are sortable. Defaults to `true`.

members.name: sortBy
members.description: The field name currently used for sorting (the primary sort).

members.name: sortOrder
members.description: The current sort order. Possible values are `"asc"` and `"desc"`. Defaults to `"asc"`.

members.name: sorts
members.description:
Every sort level, primary first, as `{ name, order }`. Shift+click on a header adds a level.
Kept in step with `sort-by` and `sort-order`, which describe the first level.

members.name: resizable
members.description:
Lets the user resize columns by dragging the header edges or with the arrow keys on the
focused handle. A column's own `resizable` overrides it.

members.name: reorderable
members.description:
Lets the user move columns by dragging a header or with Alt+Left/Right. Pinned columns move
only among the columns pinned to the same edge. A column's own `reorderable` overrides it.

members.name: columnMenu
members.description: Adds a column menu button at the end of the header that shows or hides columns.

members.name: page
members.description: The current page number (1-based). Defaults to `1`. Follows a slotted `wc-pagination`.

members.name: pageSize
members.description: The number of rows per page. Defaults to `10`. Follows a slotted `wc-pagination`.

members.name: density
members.description: Row height: `compact`, `default` or `comfortable`. Defaults to `default`.

members.name: striped
members.description: Shades every other row.

members.name: loading
members.description:
Shows a loading state: skeleton rows while there is no data, otherwise a progress bar
under the header so the current rows stay readable.

members.name: error
members.description: Shows an error in place of the rows, for example when loading failed. Announced politely.

members.name: errorText
members.description: Text of the error state. Defaults to Peacock's `tableErrorDescription` string.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the table.

members.name: emptyStateHeadline
members.description:
Headline text shown when the table has no data. Defaults to Peacock's `noItems` string
(`"No items"`).

members.name: emptyStateDescription
members.description:
Description text shown when the table has no data. Defaults to Peacock's
`noItemsDescription` string (`"There are no items to display"`).

members.name: detailTemplate
members.description:
Content of the detail row under an expanded row. Setting it adds a leading column of
expander buttons. A string is shown as text. Turns `virtual` off: detail rows vary in height.

members.name: expandedRowKeys
members.description: Keys of the rows whose details are shown. Keys are compared as strings.

members.name: groupBy
members.description:
Groups the rows by this field under collapsible header rows. Groups are ordered by value
(descending when the table is sorted descending by this field); sorting applies within
groups. In managed mode, groups keep the order the rows come in.

members.name: collapsedGroups
members.description: Keys of the collapsed groups: their `group-by` values as strings (`""` for empty values).

members.name: groupTemplate

type.text: (group: string, rows: TableRow[]) => string | TemplateResult | undefined

members.description: Custom content of a group header's label. Defaults to the group's value.

members.name: virtual
members.description:
Renders only the rows in view (plus a few on each side), for large `data` without
pagination. Every row must have the same height, `--table-row-height`; cells do not wrap.
Give the table a height. Has no effect with `detailTemplate`.

members.name: aggregateScope
members.description: Rows the footer aggregates cover: `all` rows (default) or the current `page`.

members.name: strings
members.description: Overrides Peacock's strings for this instance only.

members.name: allPagesSelected
members.description: True when every item across all pages is selected, not only the current page.

members.name: scrolledFromStart
members.description: True when content is scrolled under the start-pinned columns.

members.name: scrolledFromEnd
members.description: True when more content waits past the end-pinned columns.

members.name: activeCell
members.description: The cell that holds the grid's single tab stop. Row 0 is the column header row.

members.name: columnState
members.description: Column widths, visibility and order changed in the table.

members.name: slottedPagination
members.description: The `wc-pagination` in the footer slot, if any.

members.name: hasFooterContent
members.description: True when the footer slot has content.

members.name: dragColumn
members.description: The column being dragged to a new place.

members.name: dropTarget
members.description: The column a dragged column would be dropped on.

members.name: columnMenuOpen
members.description: True while the column menu is open.

members.name: announcement
members.description: Text for screen readers, for example after a column moved.

members.name: editingCell
members.description: The cell whose editor is open.

members.name: virtualScrollTop
members.description: Scroll offset of the virtual body, in pixels.

members.name: pendingFocus
members.description: Set when a keyboard move must focus the active cell after the next render.

members.name: resizeObserver
members.description: Watches the scroll container so the edge shadows follow resizes.

members.name: i18n
members.description: Peacock's strings and the locale counts are formatted in.

members.name: selectedKeys
members.description: The selected keys, for quick lookups while rendering.

members.name: resizeSession
members.description: The column resize in progress with the pointer.

members.name: dragSession
members.description: The header press that may become a column drag.

members.name: suppressClick
members.description: Swallows the click that ends a drag, so it does not also sort.

members.name: idPrefix
members.description: Prefix of the ids in the shadow root (detail rows).

members.name: viewCache
members.description: The memoised rows, with the inputs they were worked out from.

members.name: pendingEditorFocus
members.description: Set when the open editor must take focus after the next render.

members.name: applyingEdit
members.description: Set while an edit updates `data`, which must not reset the selection.

members.name: virtualRowHeight
members.description: Measured height of a virtual row, in pixels.

members.name: virtualViewport
members.description: Measured height a virtual body shows rows in, in pixels.

members.name: tabRowOverride
members.description: The row holding the tab stop when the active row is outside the virtual window.

members.name: exportCsv
members.description:
The rows as CSV text (RFC 4180): a header row of column labels, then one line per row, in
the current sort and grouping. By default the visible columns in display order and the
rows on the current page; `allRows` exports every row, `columns` picks columns by name
(hidden ones too). Cells hold `exportValue(row)` when the column has it, else the field.

members.name: downloadCsv
members.description: Downloads `exportCsv(options)` as a file named `options.filename` (default `table.csv`).

members.name: selectionMode
members.description: The selection mode in effect: unknown values select nothing.

members.name: isPaging
members.description: True when rows are split into pages.

members.name: headerRowCount
members.description: Rows above the data rows: the column header row, plus the column group row.

members.name: isVirtual
members.description: True when the body renders only the rows in view.

members.name: syncSorts
members.description: Keeps `sorts` and `sort-by`/`sort-order` describing the same primary sort.

members.name: getTotalItems
members.description: Total item count across pages, or `undefined` when it is unknown.

members.name: getView
members.description: The rows, memoised while the inputs they come from stay the same.

members.name: computeView
members.description:
The row pipeline: the data, sorted unless the table is managed, then grouped; the rows on
the page; and the page's display items.

members.name: getPageRows
members.description: Rows shown on the current page.

members.name: getNavItem
members.description: The group header or data row at navigation row `row` (1 for the first body row).

members.name: hasAggregates
members.description: True when a visible column has a footer aggregate.

members.name: getAriaRowCount
members.description: `aria-rowcount`: header rows plus every body and footer row, or -1 when it is unknown.

members.name: endEdit
members.description: Ends the edit; with `restoreFocus`, focus goes back to the cell.

members.name: commitEdit
members.description:
Commits the open editor. An invalid value keeps the editor open with its message. A new
value fires `cell-edit`; unless that is cancelled or the table is managed, the row in
`data` is replaced by a copy with the new value.

members.name: onSlottedPage
members.description: A slotted pagination's page event: followed, and left to bubble to the consumer.

members.name: measureVirtual
members.description: Measures the row height and the space for rows of a virtual body.

members.name: scrollRowIntoView
members.description: Scrolls a virtual body so navigation row `row` is in view.

members.name: getFocusTarget
members.description: The element that takes focus for a cell: its sort or menu button, or the cell itself.

members.name: tabRow
members.description: The navigation row holding the tab stop.

members.name: tabIndexForRow
members.description: The tab index of a one-cell row (a group header), whichever column is active.

members.name: onHeaderKeydown
members.description: Sort and reorder keys on a data column header. Returns true when the key was handled.

members.name: onCellKeydown
members.description:
Space, Enter, F2 and Ctrl+C on a body cell. Enter and Space toggle a group header or a row's
details from the expander; Enter and F2 open the editor of an editable cell.

members.name: findDropTarget
members.description: The reorderable header under `clientX` pinned like the dragged column.

members.name: measureColumn
members.description: The rendered width of a column in rem.

members.name: renderHeaderCell
members.description: One column header.

members.name: renderSelectCell
members.description: The selection control cell of a row.

members.name: renderExpandCell
members.description: The expander cell of a row with details.

members.name: renderCellEditor
members.description: The editor in place of a cell's content.

members.name: renderBodyCell
members.description: One cell of a data row.

members.name: renderRow
members.description: One data row. Every data row is rendered here.

members.name: renderDetailRow
members.description: The detail row under an expanded row: one cell across every column.

members.name: renderGroupHeaderRow
members.description: A group header: one cell across every column with the toggle, label and row count.

members.name: renderBodyRows
members.description: The page's body rows; with `virtual`, only those in view between two spacers.

members.name: renderAggregateRow
members.description: The footer row of column aggregates, after the body.

members.name: renderStateRow
members.description: A full-width row in place of the data: the empty or the error state.

members.name: renderStateMessage
members.description: The table's own empty and error message: a small illustration, a headline and a line of text.

members.name: renderFooter
members.description: The footer: the `footer` slot, usually holding a `wc-pagination`.

events.name: cell-edit
events.description: Dispatched when an inline edit is committed with a new value. Detail: `{ key, column, value, oldValue, record }`. Cancelable: call `preventDefault()` to reject the value. Unless the table is `managed`, it then updates `data` itself.
Dispatched when a cell is clicked or activated with Enter. Detail: `{ record, column, altKey, ctrlKey, metaKey, shiftKey }`.
events.name: cell-click

events.description: Dispatched when a row is clicked or activated with Enter. Detail: `{ record }`.
events.name: row-click

events.description: Dispatched when the row selection changes. Detail: `{ value, isSelectAll, allPages }`; `value` holds string keys.
events.name: selection-change

events.description: Dispatched when the table is sorted. Detail: `{ sortBy, sortOrder, sorts }`: the primary column and order, and every level as `{ name, order }`.
events.name: sort

events.description: Dispatched when the user finishes resizing a column. Detail: `{ name, width }`, width in rem.
events.name: column-resize

events.description: Dispatched when the user moves a column. Detail: `{ order }`, every column name in display order.
events.name: column-reorder

events.description: Dispatched when the user shows or hides a column from the column menu. Detail: `{ name, hidden }`.
events.name: column-visibility

events.description: Dispatched when the user expands or collapses a row's details. Detail: `{ key, expanded }`.
events.name: row-expand

events.description: Dispatched when the user expands or collapses a group. Detail: `{ group, expanded }`.
events.name: group-toggle

declarations.name: Card

cssProperties.description: Corner radius of the card. Defaults to `--shape-corner-large`.
cssProperties.name: --card-container-shape

cssProperties.description: Padding inside the card, around its children. Defaults to 0; `wc-card-content` adds its own padding.
cssProperties.name: --card-padding

cssProperties.description: Gap between the card's children. Defaults to 0.
cssProperties.name: --card-gap

members.name: variant
members.description:
Visual style of the card: `elevated` (a raised surface with a shadow), `filled` (a tonal surface)
or `outlined` (a bordered surface). Defaults to `elevated`.

members.name: disabled
members.description:
Dims the card and makes its content inert. An actionable or link card also stops responding
to clicks and leaves the tab order, unless `disabled-reason` is set.

members.name: actionable
members.description:
Makes the whole card a single button that fires `click`. Its content becomes inert, so don't
put buttons or links inside an actionable card.

members.name: disabledReason
members.description:
Why an actionable or link card is disabled. The card stays focusable and screen readers read
the reason with it.

members.name: throttleDelay
members.description:
Delay in milliseconds for throttling activation of an actionable or link card. When unset
(default), no throttle is applied.

members.name: slotHasContent
members.description: Whether the default slot holds meaningful content.

members.name: __isSoftDisabled
members.description: True when a disabled interactive card should stay focusable to expose its reason.

members.name: href
members.description:
The URL that the hyperlink points to. When set, the component renders as an `<a>` element.
Maps to the native `href` attribute.

members.name: target
members.description:
Where to display the linked URL. Maps to the native `target` attribute.
Possible values are `"_self"`, `"_blank"`, `"_parent"`, `"_top"`, or a custom frame name.
When using `"_blank"`, consider setting `rel="noopener noreferrer"` for security. Defaults to `"_self"`.

members.name: rel
members.description:
The relationship between the current document and the linked URL.
Maps to the native `rel` attribute on the rendered `<a>` element.
When `target="_blank"`, use `"noopener noreferrer"` to prevent tab-napping attacks.

members.name: download
members.description:
Causes the browser to download the linked URL instead of navigating to it.
If a string value is provided, it is used as the suggested filename.
Omit or leave undefined to preserve normal navigation behaviour.
Maps to the native `download` attribute. Only applies when `href` is set.

or `outlined` (a bordered surface). Defaults to `elevated`.

attributes.name: disabled

Makes the whole card a single button that fires `click`. Its content becomes inert, so don't
put buttons or links inside an actionable card.

attributes.name: disabled-reason
attributes.description:
Why an actionable or link card is disabled. The card stays focusable and screen readers read
the reason with it.

attributes.name: throttle-delay
attributes.description:
Delay in milliseconds for throttling activation of an actionable or link card. When unset
(default), no throttle is applied.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description:
The URL that the hyperlink points to. When set, the component renders as an `<a>` element.
Maps to the native `href` attribute.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description:
Where to display the linked URL. Maps to the native `target` attribute.
Possible values are `"_self"`, `"_blank"`, `"_parent"`, `"_top"`, or a custom frame name.
When using `"_blank"`, consider setting `rel="noopener noreferrer"` for security. Defaults to `"_self"`.

attributes.name: rel
attributes.description:
The relationship between the current document and the linked URL.
Maps to the native `rel` attribute on the rendered `<a>` element.
When `target="_blank"`, use `"noopener noreferrer"` to prevent tab-napping attacks.

attributes.name: download
attributes.description:
Causes the browser to download the linked URL instead of navigating to it.
If a string value is provided, it is used as the suggested filename.
Omit or leave undefined to preserve normal navigation behaviour.
Maps to the native `download` attribute. Only applies when `href` is set.

members.name: softDisabled

members.name: __dispatchClick

a click fired at the host (`item.click()`, Enter in the menu) into a click on the inner button

members.name: options
members.description:
Array of options to display in the dropdown.
Setting this property creates matching `<wc-option>` children automatically, after any
`<wc-option>` children of your own. Give options one way or the other.

members.name: value
members.description: The selected value. For multi-select, a comma-separated list of values.

members.name: multiple
members.description: Enable multi-select mode.

members.name: search
members.description:
Enable typeahead search.
- `'contains'`: filters options client-side.
- `'managed'`: emits a `search` event for server-controlled filtering.

members.name: allowCustom
members.description:
Lets typed text that matches no option become the value (or one of the values with
`multiple`). Turns on the search input (as `search="contains"` when `search` is not set).
With `multiple`, custom values must not contain commas.

members.name: loading
members.description: Shows a progress row in the options, for example while `search="managed"` fetches them.

members.name: strings
members.description: Overrides Peacock's strings for this instance only.

members.name: _noOptionsVisible
members.description: True when all options are filtered out by the current search query.

members.name: _visibleChipCount
members.description: How many selected chips fit on the row; the rest collapse into a "+N" chip.

members.name: _typeaheadBuffer
members.description: Characters typed on the closed combobox, matched against option labels.

members.name: _createShown
members.description: Whether the last render showed the "Create …" row, so the menu re-reads its items.

members.name: values
members.description:
The selected values, kept in sync with `value` (comma-separated). Use it with `multiple`;
for a single select it holds at most one value. The form gets one entry per value.

members.name: valueMissingText
members.description: The message for a missing required value.

members.name: validityAnchor
members.description: The element the browser points at when it reports a problem.

members.name: clearValue
members.description: Clears the selection (every value of a multi-select) and fires `change`.

members.name: emitValue
members.description: The field event contract, plus `values` for a multi-select.

members.name: _syncProgrammaticOptions
members.description:
Reconciles the `options` property with auto-generated `<wc-option>` light-DOM
children (marked `data-generated`).  Declarative children placed by the
consumer are left untouched.

members.name: _syncOptionStates
members.description:
Pushes `selected`, `multiple` and `filtered` state onto every `<wc-option>`
child element so each one can render itself correctly.

members.name: _getLabelForValue
members.description: Returns the display label for a given option value.

members.name: _searchMode
members.description: How the search input filters; `allow-custom` turns on `contains` when `search` is unset.

members.name: _findOptionByText
members.description: The enabled option whose label (or value) is the given text, ignoring case.

members.name: _showCreateOption
members.description: Whether to offer the "Create …" row: typed text that is no option and no chosen value.

members.name: _selectableOptions
members.description: Options the keyboard can choose while the list is closed.

members.name: _handleClosedTypeahead
members.description:
Typing on the closed combobox: with search, opens the list with the character in the search
input; a single select moves the selection to the next option starting with the typed text,
like a native select.

members.name: _selectWhileClosed
members.description: Selects a value from the closed combobox and fires `change` when it differs.

members.name: _handleSearchKeyDown
members.description: Keys in the search input: arrows move into the list, Enter picks the first match.

members.name: _handleMenuKeyDownCapture
members.default: { handleEvent: (event: KeyboardEvent) => { if (!this._searchMode || !this._open) return; if (!this._isPrintableKey(event) && event.key !== 'Backspace') return; if (event.key === ' ') return; // Stop the menu's own typeahead; the character lands in the input once it has focus. event.stopPropagation(); this._searchInputEl?.focus(); }, capture: true, }
members.description: With search, typing while an option has focus goes back to the input.

members.name: _stopMenuEvent
members.description: The menu's `open`/`close` bubble and are composed; they are internal to the select.

members.name: _handleMenuClose
members.description: The menu's `close` is internal too; when the list itself closes, reset the open state.

members.name: _create

members.name: _handleSlotChange
members.description: Options added or removed as children: update their state and the empty-state row.

members.description: Counts how many chips fit on one row, keeping room for the "+N" chip when some do not.

members.name: _renderStatusRow
members.description: The row under the options: progress while `loading`, else the empty state.

members.name: _renderCreateOption
members.description: The "Create …" row of `allow-custom`.

declarations.name: SECOND
declarations.description:
Relative and absolute times ("5 minutes ago", "in 3 days", "Nov 2"), and one shared ticker that
keeps every relative time on the page current. Used by `wc-relative-time`, `wc-comment` and
`wc-notification-center`.

declarations.name: parseDatetime
declarations.description: Parses an ISO 8601 date-time (or anything `Date` reads); `null` when it is not a date.

declarations.name: parseDuration
declarations.description:
Parses an ISO 8601 duration such as `P7D`, `PT12H` or `P1W` into milliseconds (months are 30.44
days, years 365.25); `null` when it is not a duration.

declarations.name: relativeTimeUnit
declarations.description:
The value and unit that describe a distance of `diff` milliseconds (negative is past): seconds
under 45 s, minutes under 45 min, hours under 22 h, days under 6.5 days, weeks under 26 days,
months under 320 days, then years. Under 45 s it is 0 seconds, which formats as "now".

declarations.name: formatRelativeTime
declarations.description: `date` relative to now in `locale`, such as "5 minutes ago", "in 3 days", "yesterday" or "now".

declarations.name: formatAbsoluteTime
declarations.description: `date` as an absolute date and time in `locale`, such as "Nov 7, 2026, 3:04 PM".

declarations.name: formatAbsoluteDate
declarations.description: `date` as a short date in `locale`: "Nov 2" in the current year, else "Nov 2, 2025".

declarations.name: formatTime
declarations.description:
`date` relative to now ("5 minutes ago"), or, when `absoluteAfter` is set and the date is
farther from now than that, an absolute date ("Nov 2").

declarations.name: refreshInterval
declarations.description:
How soon a relative time `diff` milliseconds from now may read differently: every 10 seconds
under a minute, every minute under an hour, every 5 minutes under a day, then every hour.

declarations.name: tickerRunning
declarations.description: Whether the shared ticker has a timer running. For tests.

declarations.name: onTick
declarations.description:
Calls `listener` again after `delay()` milliseconds (asked anew after each call), on one timer
shared by every subscriber on the page. The timer waits for the earliest subscriber, pauses
while the page is hidden, refreshes everyone when it is shown again, and stops when the last
subscriber leaves. Returns the unsubscribe function.

declarations.name: watchRelativeTime
declarations.description:
Calls `listener` whenever the relative time of `date()` may have changed: often for a time close
to now, rarely for one far away (see `refreshInterval`). A `null` date refreshes once a minute.
Returns the unsubscribe function.

The position of the character at `position` in a textarea, by the mirror-div technique: a

and the span's offset is the caret's. The result accounts for the textarea's scroll.

declarations.description:
Moves the mentions to follow an edit from `before` to `after`. A mention before the edit
stays, one after it moves by the change in length, and one the edit touched is dropped: its
text stays as typed, as plain text. `caret` is the caret after the edit; it places an edit
between repeated characters (typing `@` in front of `@Ana`).

followed by up to 50 characters on the same line, without a leading space or two spaces in a
row (names have spaces; sentences have more). Nothing inside an existing mention counts.

members.name: warnTaken
members.description:
Warns once that a tag is already defined by other code, such as a second copy or another
version of Peacock on the page. The existing definition stays; Peacock does not replace it.

members.name: start
members.description:
Defines the eager components and starts loading lazy ones as they appear.

By default it also wraps `Element.prototype.attachShadow` so components rendered inside any
shadow root load too. Pass `watchShadowRoots: false` (or load `loader.js?no-shadow-watch`) to
leave `attachShadow` alone, and call `loadComponents(shadowRoot)` for your own shadow roots.

members.name: watchShadowRoots
members.description:
Watches every shadow root attached from now on, as it is attached, so lazy components that a
component renders in its shadow root load as they do in the document. Patches
`attachShadow` once per page, even when two loaders run.

members.name: lazyLoadComponents
members.description: Loads the lazy components in `root` (a document or a shadow root) and those added later.

declarations.name: loadComponents
declarations.description:
Loads the Peacock components in `root` (a shadow root, element or document) and those added to
it later. Only needed with `loader.js?no-shadow-watch`.

Shared props and rendering for Peacock's text-like fields (input, textarea, number, URL, select,
date/time, color): label, helper/error/warning text, variant, size, clearable, `start`/`end`
slots and the `wc-field` frame.

It also makes the inner control accessible across the shadow boundary: `fieldAria()` gives it
an accessible name from `label`, `aria-invalid` while an error shows, and `aria-describedby`
pointing at a hidden copy of the helper or error text that lives in the same shadow root.

Components call `renderField(control, options)` in `render()`, spread `fieldAria()` onto the
native control, call `emitValue('input' | 'change')` instead of re-dispatching native events,
and implement `clearValue()` if clearing means more than `value = ''`.
